Test Steps: 1. Open the OrangeHRM login page. 2. Enter a valid username. 3. Enter the matching valid password. 4. Select Login
Expected Result: The user is authenticated and redirected to the dashboard.

Test Scenario: Verify login with an invalid username
Test Steps: 1. Open the OrangeHRM login page. 2. Enter an invalid username. 3. Enter a valid password. 4. Select Login
Expected Result: Login is denied and an appropriate authentication error is displayed.

Test Scenario: Verify login with an invalid password
Test Steps: 1. Open the OrangeHRM login page. 2. Enter a valid username. 3. Enter an invalid password. 4. Select Login
Expected Result: Login is denied and an appropriate authentication error is displayed.

Test Scenario: Verify login with both invalid credentials
Test Steps: 1. Open the OrangeHRM login page. 2. Enter an invalid username. 3. Enter an invalid password. 4. Select Login
Expected Result: Login is denied and an appropriate authentication error is displayed.

Test Steps: 1. Open the OrangeHRM login page. 2. Leave the username empty. 3. Leave the password empty. 4. Select Login
Expected Result: The form does not authenticate the user and displays required-field validation.

Test Steps: 1. Open the OrangeHRM login page. 2. Leave the username empty. 3. Enter a valid password. 4. Select Login
Expected Result: The username field displays required-field validation and login is denied.

Test Steps: 1. Open the OrangeHRM login page. 2. Enter a valid username. 3. Leave the password empty. 4. Select Login
Expected Result: The password field displays required-field validation and login is denied.

Test Steps: 1. Open the OrangeHRM login page. 2. Select the password field. 3. Enter a password.
Expected Result: Entered password characters are masked and are not displayed as plain text.

Test Steps: 1. Open the user account menu. 2. Select Logout
Expected Result: The user is logged out and returned to the login page.

Preconditions: User has logged out from OrangeHRM
Test Steps: 1. Log out of the application. 2. Use browser navigation or a previously opened protected-page URL. 3. Attempt to access the protected page.
Expected Result: The protected page is not accessible without authentication and the user is redirected to login or shown an access-control response.
